To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

theory building is an iterative process that requires the following: 1. A focus on the "why" of a phenomenon rather than the "what" 2. A focus on a limited set of variables 3. The use of parsimony 4. An emphasis on internal consistency and logical rigor

theory building is a process that involves: 1. A focus on a phenomenon of interest 2. A focus on the key constructs that are central to the phenomenon of interest 3. A focus on relationships among the key constructs 4. A focus on how the key constructs are interrelated

(1) theory is a set of interrelated concepts, statements, or propositions that propose relationships among variables; (2) theory is the foundation upon which empirical work rests and provides the basis for the development of hypotheses; and (3) theory provides a basis for understanding and predicting phenomena.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the process of theory development and how it is done in the management and organization sciences.
what makes a good theory and the processes of developing and communicating a theory.
the process and criteria for developing and evaluating good theory and how this can be accomplished within the business and management discipline.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a theory is a statement about the world that has been tested and found useful for explaining or predicting phenomena in the real world.
a theory is a statement of the relationships between concepts, which is testable and has been tested.
good theory is one that is parsimonious, elegant and testable.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a good theory is a coherent, parsimonious, and logically sound explanation for a phenomenon.
theory building is a creative process.
a good theory: is parsimonious, is logically coherent, has explanatory and predictive power, is falsifiable and refutable, is generalizable, and is testable.
The main takeaway from our work is that
theory building is a process that involves a number of stages, and that each stage is important to the development of good theory.
the theoretical contribution is the key to a strong paper.
there is no one "correct" method for building theory.
